name: lpk-dev
description: Local development marketplace for the lpk and drawio plugins.

plugins.name: lpk
plugins.description: One coding request to a delivered change: a design reviewed in at most three rounds, a test-first build with rules and a self-review per slice, a dense parallel review net with a verifier per finding, and delivery gates that read only evidence. Plus a rule catalog, the lpk Chrome DevTools server and a push guard.

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Technical diagrams and charts as editable draw.io files plus PNG in one signature style, flat or isometric, where tones carry meaning and accents group.

plugins.name: lpk-mod
plugins.description: The owner's lpk commands in Claude Code: /lpk-switch changes account (at once, when started with bin/claude-routed) and puts the builder and reviewers on DeepSeek (ccd) or back on Claude (cc), /lpk-waive releases a gate; a spawn hint and compaction instructions.
